meta.name: Akka
meta.description: In a kingdom ruled by women, matriarch Bhavani faces her biggest threat in Rudra, a ruthless rebel eyeing her land and legacy.

videos.title: The Sisterhood
videos.overview: After provoking the full fury of Pernuru's matriarchs, a fearless Rudra seeks out an old acquaintance and sets a plan in motion to take over the clan.

videos.title: Wounds and Scars
videos.overview: A devastating blow drives Bhavani toward revenge while Rudra gathers Pernuru's outsiders and strengthens her growing challenge to its rulers.

videos.title: A Challenge Wrapped in Blood
videos.overview: As Rudra wins over the local villagers and expands her influence, her foothold unsettles Bhavani's clan — who begin to uncover her connection to Pernuru.

videos.title: A Heart Turned
videos.overview: While Bhavani claims an early victory, Rudra's strategy turns the tide — unleashing bloodshed and betrayal that systematically weakens the clan's power.

videos.title: A Queen for All
videos.overview: As Pernuru's buried past resurfaces, an explosive clash erupts when Rudra joins forces with rebel men to dismantle Bhavani's authority and legacy.
